name: fundraiser-card
title: Fundraiser card
description: A fundraiser: the story in a line, the amount raised against the goal as a real progress bar, donors, days left, the organiser and a donate action.
docs: raised and goal are whole units of the currency: the card writes '€4,820 raised of €10,000' with the percentage beside it (rounded down, and never 100% before the goal is reached), and a progress bar named 'Fundraising progress' that is read in the same words, so the figure is in text and the bar only repeats it. At or over the goal it says 'Goal reached' in place of the percentage and keeps the donate button. donors and the days left are a description list; days are counted in timeZone between now and endsAt ('Days left 12', 'Ends Today'), and leaving now out reads the browser's clock after the first paint (until then the end date is written). Once endsAt has passed the card says 'Ended on 3 Oct', hides the donate button and mutes the picture. organiser is { name, image? }, credited with an avatar. A picture that does not load gives way to a quiet tile of the same shape. With href (or onOpen) the title is the one link of the card, and the Donate button (onDonate) stays its own target above it. labels carries every word.
